script_text: Stop! Capricorn, as an Earth sign, the stars are screaming at you right now. Mars in Cancer is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Saturn in Aries, creating friction in your 7th House of Partnerships and stirring up family dynamics in your 4th House of Home and Roots. If you're single, this energy attracts intense but unstable romantic interests. If you're taken, watch for power struggles with your partner as Mars squares Saturn, demanding clear communication and patience. Your 10th House of Career is blazing with the Sun in Leo, demanding you step into a leadership role and showcase your talents. While your 2nd House of Money remains steady, avoid impulsive spending. The warning: don't sign any contracts or make commitments today, as the Mars-Saturn square can obscure details. But a blessing hides in your 8th House: an unexpected financial influx could surprise you. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
